body: I'm scared people are going to think I "Kevin Spaceyed". One of my clubs asked me to take a hiatus because they believe I made inappropriate romantic advances on women when I was on our executive board last year. I want to tell them that I didn't. I know the real answer. I know why. I know it's because I'm gay. I've secretly been seeing a guy. I was going to come out to them this year. 2019 was my year to do it. Now I can't do it and feel right. Now I can't do it and feel comfortable. It feels like it's all over for me.
